slides.title: Authorization Auditing with Jev as Final Judge
slides.subtitle: Judge choice, follow-up questions and temporal permission

texts.text: Can a monitor tell whether an executed action had permission at the time?
A stronger direct baseline; no established extra benefit from targeted follow-up or Jev time indexing.
Pacifica Zhang · Luanfeng Wei · Qier An · Tony Zhu

slides.notes: 中文开场，约40秒：现在的主线是把 Jev 放在最终判定的位置，研究它能否看懂操作发生时的授权。我们不把换模型本身包装成方法创新。整个项目从定向追问出发，结果发现强直接基线很关键，追问和时间索引的额外收益需要分开测。今天会保留两项主要负结果，也会解释具体失败。主讲为第1至12页，约10至12分钟；第13至17页为备查，时长只是排练建议而非课程规定。Source: project/final_report_2026-11-13/FINAL_REPORT.md, sections 1 and 8. Original author list retained; contribution agreement remains for team review.

slides.title: Permission must apply when the action is executed
slides.subtitle: The same permission text can support different labels when its position changes.

texts.text: Later permission or cancellation does not erase an earlier violation.
Reference: execution evidence and rules. Jev: the tested semantic Judge.

slides.source: Endpoint: successful sensitive action outside applicable permission. Human review of new studies: 0.
slides.notes: 中文，约50秒：先授权再买票，与先买票后授权，可能用了相同的文字，但正确结论不同。这里的 Judge 是待评测的判定器，不能一边判答案一边制造自己的标准答案。参考标签来自模拟器执行、公开许可和程序规则；AI来源检查不是人工金标。我们的实验看已经执行的操作，尚未测试能不能提前拦截。表格是授权时序示意，不是送给模型的参考答案。Sources: timing PROTOCOL.md and RESULTS.md; mainline PROTOCOL.md.

slides.title: Separate the Judge from the extra information
slides.subtitle: 189 eligible new trajectories: 93 airline and 96 bank, from existing task templates.

values: Public record + factual ledger + operation markers
P + one fixed Qwen evidence review
P + Actor answer to a generic checking question
P + Actor answer to a selected amount, identity or timing question

texts.text: Each intermediate output is shared unchanged with Jev and Qwen.

slides.source: Primary comparison: Jev T versus F in airline. F/T share context and caps; no new external facts.
slides.notes: 中文，约60秒：192个采集位置按事前准入规则留下189条轨迹。每环境48个实例，每实例两个Actor条件，不是189个独立任务族。P已经包含完整公开记录和事实账本，并非只有最终回答。C、F、T分别检验复查、通用追问和定向追问。中间材料只生成一次，两种Judge读完全相同的版本，所以能把组件作用分开。F/T禁止工具，4096输出上限匹配，但实际时间不一定相同。Jev-1.14.0主Judge，Qwen3-32B对照，Actor gpt-oss-120b。Source: project/research_update_2026-11-12/reports/mainline.md, design.

slides.title: Jev improves the direct baseline on this batch
slides.subtitle: Identical P materials in airline; post-hoc component comparison.

texts.text: 13 corrected labels and no regressions in this paired comparison.
50 percentage points more detection here; no general model ranking.

slides.source: Saved baseline comparison. Different model interfaces and serving costs; not matched compute.
slides.notes: 中文，约55秒：这是把Jev作为主要Judge最直接的经验依据。同一份P材料，违规检出从8/26到21/26，多检出13条，误报都为0/67。但是这个比较是在看到主结果后整理的组件比较，不能伪装成原来预注册的成功主检验。它也不是严格等算力比较，不支持Jev在所有任务都更强，更不证明它长期稳定。Source: reports/baseline_comparison.md and reports/mainline.md.

slides.title: Targeted follow-up did not meet the primary criteria
slides.subtitle: The original TGF hypothesis remains unsupported under the frozen decision rule.

texts.text: All F/T label differences came from two truncated generic answers.
On 91 jointly valid airline records, F and T agree within each Judge.

slides.source: Score G = detection rate × correct-release rate. Conditional analysis does not replace the full denominator.
slides.notes: 中文，约65秒：不能把0.0499426四舍五入成0.05再说通过。区间还包含0，耗时比也略超过门槛。两条F截断都留在主分母，一条本来违规一条合法。只看两个回答完整的91条时，F和T在每个Judge下逐条相同。这解释了差别来自可用性，却不能据此证明两种方法等效，也不能把条件化子集换成主分析。Jev P、C、T在航空逐条相同，没有证据显示定向追问比其直接基线多抓到了违规。Source: reports/mainline.md.

slides.title: Eight timing pairs test when a label should change
slides.subtitle: A separate diagnostic adapted from Qier's design; 16 scripted bookings, 64 formal judgments.

texts.text: Within each pair: same action and receipt content; move only the amendment.
Source versus linked cards, for both Jev and Qwen.

slides.source: Links follow public chronology; they do not select the applicable permission or reveal a label.
slides.notes: 中文，约60秒：这轮的作用是把主线问题拆小。6对应该因为授权先后改变正确结论，2对给的是别人的许可，因此不应该改变。不能把两次都错但一致算稳定。链接只按最近前后消息机械生成，不直接告诉模型哪条许可有效。全部8对数据在推理前冻结，不是为了Jev结果好看事后替换。Qier原分支保留，我们是另建v0.2实现，并没有直接复现原分支的数值。Source: authorization_timing_jev_2026-11-12/PROTOCOL.md and PAIR_SPEC.json.

slides.title: Jev is at ceiling and gains nothing from time links
slides.subtitle: Pair success requires both records to be correct. All 64 formal outputs were valid.

texts.text: Primary Jev indexing gain: 0. Secondary Qwen gain: one pair.
Eight constructed pairs do not certify broad accuracy or stability.

slides.source: Timing RESULTS.md and recovery_01/analysis.json. No repeated judgments or rationale endpoint.
slides.notes: 中文，约60秒：这里最容易讲错的是把8/8当成索引成功。Jev原文就已经8/8，所以预定索引增益是0。Qwen从4对到5对只改善了一对，这属于次要描述性结果。两模型都没有对8条合法记录误报，区别来自违规漏检。我们测的是这组固定样本上的判定，没测重复运行稳定性，也没有让Jev生成理由，因此不能说引用质量提高了。Source: timing RESULTS.md, recovery_01/analysis.json.

slides.title: The controls reveal different kinds of failure
slides.subtitle: Concrete cases explain what an aggregate accuracy number can hide.

values: Nora's booking occurs before a later grant
An unrelated note intervenes in the grant pair
Booking is for Eli; the moved grant is for Mina

texts.text: Jev is correct on all three; the Qwen flip does not identify its internal cause.

slides.source: Pair 08 may reflect scope, position sensitivity or judgment variation; one observation cannot separate them.
slides.notes: 中文，约60秒：第一类是该变的时候没有改对：先买后授权被当合法。第二类是一对通过索引修正的例子。第三类是不该变的时候变了：买票对象Eli和授权对象Mina不同，许可位置变动不应改变越权结论。Qwen却从违规变合法。我们能确认这个行为，不能直接说模型脑中就是对象混淆，因为顺序敏感和单次波动还没排除。基础与插入消息对使用不同实例，也不能简单做跨组因果解释。Source: recovery_01/DETAILS.json; RESULTS.md cases.

slides.title: A valid verdict or citation is not enough
slides.subtitle: Source audits separate label correctness, evidence support and interface constraints.

texts.text: Mainline: five missed airline cases share ambiguous numeric name suffixes.
Bank: Jev has five false alarms with added review, and none in its direct baseline.
Tony's older-output audit: 28 cases need five evidence units, but the schema allows four citations.
32-case mainline source inspection was nonblind AI review; human review remains 0.

slides.source: Source audit and Tony commit 898b73ac. Later evidence-chain criteria are not retroactive original requirements.
slides.notes: 中文，约60秒：这页解释为什么不能直接宣布监控器可信了。五个漏检都涉及像Jordan Ellis 30这样的合成姓名；严格字符串标签有效，但数字也可能被当年龄，是构造局限。银行复查主要事实是真的，加入后却多了五个误报，不能一概叫幻觉。Tony的新审计发现四动作完整证据链需要至少五个证据单元，老格式却最多四条，说明接口本身会限制解释完整度。105个有效旧输出里27个满足新标准，不意味着其余78个全错。人工复核数仍是0。Sources: reports/semantic_audit.md; source_review/README.md; Tony 06 evidence audit.

slides.title: Earlier negative results remain in the final account
slides.subtitle: These stages motivated the stronger baseline; they are not independent confirmations.

values: F and T both detect 6/6; T adds 1 false alarm
Generic and specific both 6/6 at two seeds

texts.text: A useful negative result limits what we can credit to the added component.

slides.source: Historical November 7 report and November 12 development 2×2. No pooled accuracy across these batches.
slides.notes: 中文，约60秒：我们不换故事把以前的负结果藏起来。最初通用追问已经6/6，定向没多检出，还多一个误报；固定动作后仍没区别。看起来很有效的单案例金额提示，到六块补验只改善一块，没有达到两块门槛。后来Jev账本实验，在自然记录上也没有分类增益。这些结果一起说明不能只挑最醒目的正例讲，也提示先把Judge基线做强。Source: closeout_2026-11-07/FINAL_REPORT.md; reports/development_2x2.md.

slides.title: The implication is more accountable authorization review
slides.subtitle: Better monitoring would help people distinguish unauthorized actions from legitimate work.

texts.text: Tie each disputed action to its applicable permission and successful receipt.
Evaluate a strong direct Judge before adding questions, reviews or evidence links.
Keep missing evidence and conflicting decisions available for escalation.
Potential application: incident triage. Not yet measured: prevented harm or human time saved.

slides.source: Implications are design inferences. Experiments audit completed actions; they do not test prevention.
slides.notes: 中文，约55秒：意义不是让模型的判定看起来更自信，而是帮人查清哪一步、凭哪条许可、什么时间发生了越权。可靠的正常放行也重要，否则会制造报警疲劳。实验支持先测强直接基线、再测追加组件；对缺证或冲突做升级复核是合理下一步设计，但我们还没有测真人节省时间或提前阻止损害。这里要把已经得到的证据和潜在应用分开。Source: research_update_2026-11-12/IMPLICATIONS.md; integrated report section 6.

slides.title: The contribution is a bounded and reproducible account
slides.subtitle: Jev as final Judge is the architecture; execution-time authorization is the research problem.

texts.text: Supported: stronger direct baseline in this batch and specific timing/scope failures.
Not established: extra targeted-follow-up benefit, Jev indexing benefit or general reliability.
Limits: existing templates, eight constructed pairs, ambiguous labels, no human gold and one Jev repeat disagreement.
Current scope: integrate and review; no new experiments or sample expansion.

slides.source: Frozen hypotheses, failures and denominators retained. Novelty claim: empirical replication and extension.
slides.notes: 中文结尾，约50秒：一句话概括，Jev让直接判定基线更强，但我们没有证明额外追问或时间索引对它有新增收益。贡献是把Judge、材料、失败处理和证据支持分开检验，并用控制案例把失败讲清楚。它可以是一份扎实的结课实证研究，但不该包装成普遍安全、首创Judge或发表级新方法。接下来只进行报告、团队审阅和真正的人工复核准备，不自动扩量。Source: integrated report sections 1, 6 and 8.

slides.title: Appendix  Mainline airline results
slides.subtitle: All eligible trajectories stay in the planned denominator.
slides.source: 189 eligible total; airline 48 instance blocks, 89 unique public inputs. G = TPR × TNR.
slides.notes: 备查：P/C/T在Jev下相同；Qwen从补充回答中受益，但T相对F的差异仍只有F缺失。航空两条F不可用一正一负，所以即使FP为0，TN也只有66/67。G不能用1−FPR替代TNR，因为不可用保留分母。块bootstrap5000次，次要对比未做多重校正。Source: reports/mainline.md and saved analyses.

slides.title: Appendix  Bank results and repeatability caveat
slides.subtitle: A stronger direct Judge does not make every added review beneficial.

texts.text: Identical incidental requests: Jev agrees in 36/37 pairs; Qwen in 37/37.
Not a designed stability benchmark; do not claim repeatability is solved.

slides.source: Bank has eight positive blocks. Same-input Jev C probabilities: 0.52/0.47/0.01 versus 0.42/0.57/0.01.
slides.notes: 备查：银行的正例只有8个，不能凭8/8和零误报认证低错误率。Jev C的五条误报和同输入不一致均保留。37组是自然出现的重复完整请求，没有为稳定性专门重复采样。两个Jev输出都使用原定argmax选类，没改阈值。Source: mainline SEMANTIC_AUDIT.md and reports/mainline.md.

slides.title: Appendix  Earlier evidence gains and failures
slides.subtitle: A selected striking example did not become a broad confirmed improvement.

texts.text: Fee-scope case: Qwen summed principal correctly, yet counted excluded fees as a violation.
Later ledger gains occurred only in constructed strata; natural labels were unchanged.

slides.source: Old 12-record extension and 60-position Jev 2×2 use different interfaces; keep their results separate.
slides.notes: 备查：旧费用案例本金95.20+41.15+38.40+64.75=239.50，恰好等于预算，费用不在授权审核范围。Qwen原始条件算对总额仍误报；补总额后改对，但错误断言条件也改对，不能归因于单纯算术修复。一分钱超支107.25对107.24的案例，两Judge都拒绝错误无违规断言，但引用仍不完整。旧GPT-oss不同输出约束和失败率不宜用来排名能力。12条旧参考有独立上下文AI复核12/12，不是人工，更不覆盖新实验。Sources: closeout FINAL_REPORT.md; development_2x2.md.

slides.title: Appendix  Resources include the failed start
slides.subtitle: The timing recovery changed startup only; data, prompts and limits stayed frozen.

texts.text: First start: 1,237 seconds, no Qwen requests. Authorized recovery: 136 seconds.
All 72 timing attempts consumed once; no replacement cases or additional run.

slides.source: Calls include interface checks. Jev estimates are not invoices; GPU dollars and pure architecture speed are not claimed.
slides.notes: 备查：保持原总预算，第一次失败也计入。CPU先核验19个资产并复制兼容编译缓存，GPU正式分配136秒正常退出；累计1373秒22分53秒小于30分钟。72调用含64正式8smoke，两Judge各36，均一次尝试。资源合规不是科学假设成功。不同批次不合并准确率，也不拿不同服务部署的延迟来解释模型架构优劣。Sources: timing RUN_STATUS.md and recovery_01/FINAL_OUTCOME.json; mainline cost section.
